school.name: Mott Hall High School
school.overview: Its a new day at Mott Hall High School, with two new school leaders. Four year college acceptance has increased to over 60% and 85% of seniors graduated last year. We teach students to be critical thinkers who are college and career ready. We also provide a space for those who need to heal from traumatic experience, all students now receive advisory. Our teachers strive to be culturally responsive. We passionately serve our students and regard them as family.
